screen.tinyrelics.title: Tiny Relics: settings
screen.tinyrelics.craft.tip: Turn it off and this item's recipe disappears for every player. Items that already exist stay.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_radius.tip: How many blocks in every direction from the player the lightning reaches. Default is 32.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_fire.tip: When on, fire appears under every target. Off by default.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_monsters.tip: Off: the hammer hits everyone. On: only hostile mobs, animals and players are safe.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.keeping_charm: Keep it in your inventory. When you die one charm breaks and all your items come back after you respawn. It does not keep experience.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.thor_hammer: Right-click: lightning strikes everything in range. Shift + right-click: throw, the hammer hits the first target and returns. Super ability key: jump 20 blocks up and slam the ground, sending out a ring of lightning.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.chaos_boomerang: Right click: flies at the nearest enemy and jumps on to the others, then comes back. It can be thrown again half a second after it is back. Shift + right click: circles you for 30 seconds blocking monster hits, then a 10 second cooldown.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.blood_blade: Hit: 20% chance to cause bleeding. Right-click at one heart with enemies near: drains their life and heals you. Shift + right-click: a blood vortex heals players and pets within 8 blocks for 5 seconds and leaves you at 2 hearts. Each ability has a 2 minute cooldown.
item.tinyrelics.undead_staff.tooltip2: Shift + right-click: summon 2 skeletons and 3 zombies
item.tinyrelics.undead_staff.tooltip3: Key %s: blue fire once enough souls are gathered
screen.tinyrelics.staff_kills.tip: How many mobs you must kill to charge the blue fire. Default is 20.
screen.tinyrelics.desc.undead_staff: Right-click: wither skull, 1.5 second cooldown. Shift + right-click: 2 skeletons and 3 zombies for a minute, they attack whoever hits you; 2 minute cooldown. Kill mobs with the staff in your inventory, then press the fire key: blue fire erupts in a 30×30 area around you.
screen.tinyrelics.staff_grief.tip: Off: the wither skull explodes but leaves blocks alone. On: it breaks them like a real wither's skull.
item.tinyrelics.blood_blade.tooltip3: Shift + right-click: a blood vortex heals allies at the cost of your health
msg.tinyrelics.blade_vortex_health: The blood vortex needs more than two hearts
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_slam_radius.tip: How far the landing after the jump reaches. Default is 10.
screen.tinyrelics.hammer_slam_fire.tip: On: the sky strike sets everyone in range on fire. Off: damage only.
item.tinyrelics.necro_armor.tooltip: Full set: what you kill rises as your servant
screen.tinyrelics.desc.necro_armor: Helmet 2, chestplate 5, leggings 3, boots 1. With all four pieces on, every mob or player you kill rises where it died as a zombie or a skeleton and fights for you for 30 seconds. No more than 5 such servants at once.
msg.tinyrelics.vanish_wait: Vanishing will be ready in %s s
screen.tinyrelics.desc.chaos_armor: Hood 3, chestplate 6, leggings 3, boots 1. The full set gives Speed III. Key I: the wearer vanishes in a cloud of steam, armor and weapon included, mobs lose track, and Speed V is granted. Cooldown 2 minutes.
screen.tinyrelics.vanish_seconds.tip: How many seconds the vanishing and Speed V last. 10 by default.
item.tinyrelics.blood_armor.tooltip2: Only the blood of peaceful animals refills them
msg.tinyrelics.rain_wait: Blood rain will be ready in %s s
screen.tinyrelics.desc.blood_armor: Crown 4, chestplate 7, leggings 5, boots 2. The full set gives 4 blood hearts: each peaceful animal killed returns one. Key I: blood rain. Crafted from blood ingots, which the blood altar makes.
screen.tinyrelics.rain_cooldown.tip: Seconds between two blood rains. 180 by default.
screen.tinyrelics.rain_radius.tip: How far the rain reaches from its centre. 4 is nine blocks across. 4 by default.
item.tinyrelics.thor_armor.tooltip2: Full set: lightning strikes whoever hits you
screen.tinyrelics.desc.thor_armor: Mantle 400, leggings 350, boots 250, no helmet. Cannot be crafted and never breaks. With all three pieces on, whoever hurts the wearer is struck by lightning in return, at most twice a second. The armor has no settings.

guide.tinyrelics.home.title: Guide
guide.tinyrelics.home.text:
This book is about the relics of Tiny Relics: four armor sets, their weapons and everything they are made of.
The tabs on the right open the chapters, the arrows at the bottom turn the pages. Point at an item in a recipe to see its name.
# Keys
I — armor ability.
R — weapon super ability.
K — mod settings, server operators only.
# Lost the book?
Craft a new one from a book and a gold nugget.
guide.tinyrelics.necro.title: Necromancer
guide.tinyrelics.necro.armor:
# Armor
Helmet 2, chestplate 5, leggings 3, boots 1: 11 armor in all.
With the full set everyone you kill rises as a zombie or a skeleton and fights for you for half a minute. Five servants at most.
guide.tinyrelics.necro.staff:
# Staff of the Undead
Right click — shoots a wither skull.
Shift + right click — 2 skeletons and 3 zombies climb out of the ground and fight for you for a minute.
Every kill with the staff in your inventory gives a soul. With enough souls, R lights blue fire all around you.
guide.tinyrelics.necro.resources:
# Bones and souls
Skeletons drop bones.
The bone crusher grinds a bone into bone powder, and soul sand gives a soul half the time.
The soul press squeezes 8 powder into a bone ingot.
Both burn gunpowder: one is enough for 8 jobs.
The armor and the staff are made of ingots and souls.
guide.tinyrelics.chaos.title: Chaos Assassin
guide.tinyrelics.chaos.armor:
# Armor
Hood 3, chestplate 6, leggings 3, boots 1: 13 armor in all.
The full set gives lasting Speed III.
Key I: you vanish completely for 10 seconds and get Speed V; mobs lose sight of you. Cooldown 2 minutes.
guide.tinyrelics.chaos.boomerang:
# Chaos Boomerang
Right click — flies at the nearest monster and jumps on to the next ones, up to 10, then comes back. It can be thrown again half a second after it is back in your hand.
Shift + right click — circles you for 30 seconds, hitting monsters nearby and blocking their damage. After the shield, a 10 second cooldown.
guide.tinyrelics.chaos.resources:
# Cloth and thread
Endermen drop enderman skin half the time, phantoms always drop a piece of wing.
The shadow loom weaves 2 skins into chaos cloth.
The phantom spooler winds a piece of wing into phantom thread.
They need no fuel but work only at night.
The armor is made of cloth and thread.
guide.tinyrelics.blood.title: Blood Master
guide.tinyrelics.blood.armor:
# Armor
Crown 4, chestplate 7, leggings 5, boots 2: 18 armor in all.
The full set gives 4 blood hearts on top of your own. They do not come back by themselves: killing peaceful animals fills them.
Key I calls a blood rain: the clouds above you hurt everyone under them, up to 3 hearts. Cooldown 3 minutes.
guide.tinyrelics.blood.blade:
# Blood Blade
A hit makes the target bleed one time in five.
Right click on your last heart: the blade drains life from monsters nearby and heals you fully.
Shift + right click — a blood vortex heals you, your allies and your pets.
Each ability has a 2 minute cooldown.
guide.tinyrelics.blood.resources:
# Blood and the altar
Peaceful animals drop clean blood, hostile mobs except skeletons drop dirty blood.
In the blood altar 30 drops of clean blood become a blood ingot.
30 drops of dirty blood and 4 water bottles are cleaned into 30 clean drops.
The armor and the blade are made of blood ingots.
guide.tinyrelics.thor.title: Thor
guide.tinyrelics.thor.hammer:
# Thor's Hammer
Right click — lightning strikes everyone around.
Shift + right click — the hammer flies ahead, strikes the first target with lightning and comes back.
R — strike from the sky: you are thrown up and slammed down, burning everyone around the landing spot.
The hammer never hurts you or your pets.
guide.tinyrelics.thor.armor:
# Armor of Thor
Mantle, leggings and boots, no helmet. Never breaks.
With the full set, whoever hurts you is struck by lightning.
# Legend
The hammer and the armor of Thor cannot be crafted: they come only from creative mode.
guide.tinyrelics.shop.title: Curio Shop
guide.tinyrelics.shop.charm:
# Charm of Keeping
While the charm is in your inventory, you keep all your things when you die. Experience is not kept.
Each death uses up one charm.
guide.tinyrelics.shop.more:
# What next
The merchant promises new curiosities. Look here again when the mod is updated.
guide.tinyrelics.roadmap.title: Roadmap
guide.tinyrelics.roadmap.archer.about:
White wings, a halo and a bow of light.
Arrows that fall from the sky itself.
guide.tinyrelics.roadmap.pirate.about:
A musket, a cutlass
and a faithful green parrot.
His own ship and his own treasure.
guide.tinyrelics.roadmap.shogun.about:
An oni mask and a long katana.
A strike too fast to see.
